output.one_liner: Plaid is a financial data connectivity and payments platform that enables applications to securely connect to users' financial accounts and access data like transactions, balances, and identity information.

auth.notes: API uses client_id and secret; end-user authentication to financial institutions occurs via Plaid Link, which uses OAuth but is separate from API authentication.

evidence.snippet: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a `client_id` and `secret`. These may be sent either in the request body or in the headers `PLAID-CLIENT-ID` and `PLAID-SECRET`.
You connect by pasting keys from your Plaid account into a Composio connection.

access.notes: Free Sandbox environment with unlimited test Items; production access available on pay-as-you-go plan starting at $0/month.

evidence.snippet: Get started for free. $0/month, pay-as-you-go. Best for startups & new businesses
Can I try Plaid for free? Absolutely. Our Free Trial allows you to make API calls using live data.
The Plaid Sandbox is a free and fully-featured environment for application development and testing.
OpenAPI is a standard format for describing RESTful APIs that allows those APIs to be integrated with tools
The Plaid API is specified in our Plaid OpenAPI GitHub repo.
A webhook is an HTTP request used to provide push notifications.
Rate Limit Exceeded errors. Occur when an excessive number of requests are made in a short period of time.
Pssst -- I also moonlight as your IDE's research librarian! Plug me in via the Plaid MCP Server.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free sandbox credentials, REST API with OpenAPI spec, documented webhooks, and existing Composio toolkit with 70 tools enable immediate buildability.

overview_evidence.snippet: API Reference. Explore server-side API libraries and integrate with API endpoints
